description_en: Queries the assets that are affected by the risk item detected in configuration assessment based on a specified check item
description_zh: 查询指定云平台配置检查项影响的资产
name: DescribeRiskCheckItemResult

parameters.description_en: The source IP address of the request.
parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.description_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.description_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the check item.

> For more information about the IDs and details of the check items that can be used in configuration assessment, see [DescribeRiskCheckResult](~~113520~~).
parameters.description_zh:
指定要查询的云平台配置检查项的ID。
> 云平台配置检查支持的检查项的ID及其详细信息，请参见[DescribeRiskCheckResult](~~DescribeRiskCheckResult~~)。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

> For more information about the IDs and details of the check items that can be used in configuration assessment, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113520.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的云平台配置检查项的ID。
> 云平台配置检查支持的检查项的ID及其详细信息，请参见[DescribeRiskCheckResult](~~DescribeRiskCheckResult~~)
parameters.name: item_id

parameters.description_en: The number of the page to return.
parameters.description_zh: 指定分页查询时当前页的页码。
parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.description_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

> We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.
parameters.description_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
parameters.help_en:
